sense.text:
In the midst of all these wars, all this bloodshed, there are casualties. But the twelve tribes of Israel are not standing with any of them. We are standing only for the twelve tribes of Israel.

“Thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.”

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” In these last days they said, “Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation.” Think about the United Nations, the League of Nations, whatever you want to call them: they have taken crafty counsel to set us up and overthrow the twelve tribes.

“That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” The twelve tribes are scattered abroad, mainly in the sides of the north. When you see all the tribulation and all the wars, it is all of the Lord, and the Lord has them in derision, because they are taking crafty counsel against the twelve tribes of Israel.
“They have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee.” They are of one accord against the twelve tribes.

“The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes.” Edom is the so-called white man; the Ishmaelites are the Arabs. So Israel, do not get caught up feeling sorry for kids getting bombed and so on. We are only here for the twelve tribes of Israel.

Look at the order. First Edom, the proud man, the one who set up the crafty counsel; second the Ishmaelites. This war is between a man so proud that he will not humble down and a man known to be wild and crazy. What does Israel have to do with that business between the two of them? Our part is our salvation, not inserting ourselves into their problems.

This is the Most High’s hit list: number one is Edom, then Ishmael. The sub-Saharan slave trade, the biggest slave trade to date, was done on us, and that is why the Lord has to bring payback on these nations. He is unraveling it right before our eyes. That is why we are not to be entangled in the affairs of this world.
Why do we say they are all confederate? “When I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”: bring again means reverse the captivity.

“I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat”: the valley of decision. They are there in the valley of decision right now, and it is the Lord who is orchestrating it all. Look at it on the spiritual side: it is a play being played out, and the Most High is the mastermind letting these things come to pass.

“And will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel”: the Lord’s heritage is the twelve tribes of Israel, “whom they have scattered among the nations”, scattered as the sand of the sea.

“And parted my land.” They parted the Lord’s land. Iran is in our land. The Palestinians, all of these bastards are in our land. These are not the real Jews; the real Jews are over here in America. Even the Greater Israel that Netanyahu set up is biblical, but it is not going to come to pass with these bastards. It is for us to obtain.

Israel, do not get caught up in these emotions. You have no win in this fight. Your fight is with the Lord, your salvation, and getting yourself together, because if you do not, you will not see the promise made to our forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. The Lord has not dealt so with any other nation. If you acknowledge we are the twelve tribes but want to engraft all the other nations, when will you acknowledge that they have to give us back our land and everything that belongs to us? It is hypocrisy.

“I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.” The Lord gave other nations for us. That means the Lord brought blood and destruction on our behalf.

“Since thou wast precious in my sight.” Not all nations: the Christianity song says yellow, black and white, they are all precious in his sight, and we refuse to acknowledge that. It is the twelve tribes of Israel who are precious in his sight. “Thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee”: the Lord loves us.

“Therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.” That is the ransom. He did not say he would spare the little Arab kids, or the Israeli kids (Israeli meaning planted into the land). He said, I gave people for your life, no matter how cute the little kids look in these videos.

“I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west; I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back.” “Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory.” The Lord created us for his glory: “I have formed him; yea, I have made him.”

“Who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses.” The Lord has dealt only with us from the beginning. He is the God of prophecy, and he says to everybody else, bring forth your witnesses.

“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” We are the Lord’s witnesses. “I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.”

All this destruction the Lord is bringing on the other nations is only to usher in and set the twelve tribes of Israel back in their rightful place: those that are keeping the commandments and striving.

precepts.why:
See how much the Lord loves us: he tells us what is about to go down. He put it in front of us in prophecy: where it is going down, who is involved in the chaos, who is conspiring against Israel and the part each will play. He warns us not to meddle with them, and tells us to work on our salvation.

“Come out of her, my people.” Who are his people? Israel, the only nation with the problem of Isaiah 3:12, children their oppressors and women ruling over them, the only one with a southern kingdom and a northern kingdom. So it is only Israel he is calling.

“That ye be not partakers of her sins”: that we not be a part of the plagues and sins coming on this place, the land of the north where Esau dwells, or on the valley of decision where everyone gathers for that great day of Armageddon. “And that ye receive not of her plagues”: that we do not receive the death and destruction on the way when the Most High shows up to give them their decision.

sense.text:
Look at Iran’s demands: withdraw from the Middle East, lift the sanctions, pay reparations. It is not really about nuclear weapons. It is about the petrodollar, America’s dominance over the world economy; the lifeline of America is fake dollar, fiat currency. Let the war continue. There will be no negotiating; it will be dragged out, $10,000 drones against million-dollar missiles, until everybody, America above all, is bankrupt.

“The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.” He loves to see bloodshed. The Lord likes to see a sword, a shield, bucklers and blood on a battlefield, an intimate war, not shooting from long distances. At the end of the day, the Lord loves war.
“Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea”: that is nations being sacrificed on our behalf. “His chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.”

“Thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.” The Lord loves war. “Thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.”

The Most High loves his people. And as these wars come and these things happen, hard times are coming for Israel.

precepts.why:
The Lord sacrificed Egypt. He is a man of war, and his vengeance is on all the nations read in Psalms 83; he has a big payback coming for all of them. Egypt is one example.

“Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong.” Did all that power help them? No. All their chariots and war materials did not help them at all.

“But they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!” We did not look to our God to save us. The God of Israel is the only God that is going to save us out of all this foolishness. These wars will come to thermonuclear ICBMs and nuclear weapons in full effect, and many will die. Ask yourself: will it be us?

“Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words.” Evil is set for all these nations; they will be destroyed. Where will you be? If you are in confederacy with these nations, thinking all nations will be saved together, Christ is not coming to save you. That is not the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

This shows how unstoppable it is. The wild and crazy ones made demands of the proud one: get out of our country and pay us back for the destruction. The proud man is not going to do that. So God says, if you will not do it this way, I have another way: I have you in the trick bag.

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: that is New Babylon, America. “Abundant in treasures”: rich from all the nations, because they took the land, took the resources, went in and oppressed the people. “Thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.” It is time for them to step down; they will not, so God will put them down.

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself”: the same Lord of hosts, the God that is a man of war. “Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers.” Those caterpillars are the wild and crazy ones. If proud Babylon gives in to the demands, it loses its sovereignty over the economy, and that is the downfall; because he is prideful he will not, and that leads to war, and God activates the caterpillars on the back end. Either way, prophecy comes to pass.

sense.text:
As we see these things transpire, Israel has to gird itself up. They are talking about fuel restrictions, not being able to drive on certain days by your license plate; the Philippines and the countries that depend on the Strait of Hormuz are already in a fuel crisis. Just like COVID in Asia, do not think it will not reach us. If you have that mindset, you are ignorant of the destruction that must come in the midst of our salvation.

“Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” That is Christianity.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled.” No matter what wars we see, do not get into an anxiety spirit, watching the conflict constantly, afraid the bombs that hit Babylon will hit where you stay, hoping they calm it all down so the other nations can stay in our land and we keep using the white man’s petrodollar, which is monopoly money. The Lord says do not be troubled: “for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.”

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines.” Famine comes from lack of gas; from farm equipment that cannot produce; from eighteen-wheelers that cannot haul cattle and livestock across continents; from the Strait of Hormuz locking in food and supplies. Do not get relaxed in these last days. Leadership has been telling Israel to prepare, but many would rather have a Gucci bag or keep up with Nike. Those shoes made in China or Vietnam will not keep you warm or feed you. Step in two inches of water in them and walk another twenty or thirty minutes: your feet will be wet and sore. You cannot be on the move, on foot over terrain, in that. You will not make it.

“All these are the beginning of sorrows.”

“Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted.” That is how we know the end is not yet but is coming close. Censorship only goes so far. Mossad using Epstein to manipulate the politicians and keep them in check can only go so long. There is a lot of evil and suppression, and it will come to the point where they say, we have seen enough of the prophecies, it is time to start killing these guys.

That is the timeline: “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you.” They will not kill everybody; they will kill those of Revelation 12:17.

“And ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake”: for the black Messiah, not white Jesus. Everybody in the world loves white Jesus. Say Christ is black and watch the faces of the Christians. Christ is a black man, a man of color, and we cannot be ashamed to confess that.

“And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another.” All these things are part of the sequel of this story. For so long we have been cheering on the villains in these movies, and now the reality check is that your oppressor is the villain, and your oppressor hates you. All nations being saved would mean that the other nations would still be over you: salvation for keeping the commandments, but nothing else changed. White Jesus will never show up; if you see any big white man passing in the sky, run, because you are going back into captivity. Yet a lot of these camps bring them into their camps because Bob has good credit. That is why it will not work to keep joining hand in hand with your oppressor in these last days.

There are only twelve gates to get into the kingdom. Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling; do not try to vouch to the Most High or to Christ for Esau coming into the kingdom. That will be a bad day for you.

precepts.why:
We are living in a very precious time. The Holy Spirit is upon the prophets of God: we see what is going on, correlate it with the scriptures, and edification goes throughout, so that we can see this Bible is a true book and that God controls everything. Showing what is happening on the earth is prophesying, and it is what the prophets have always done.

“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That is what we see now: war, and behind war comes pestilence.

This confirms what Jeremiah stated. This is not a normal war; it is the beginning of World War III, and it is shaking the whole earth. And it is no coincidence that while war is happening, black men are on the streets in purple and gold, prophesying and teaching with all authority. That is a new thing on the earth.

“I have commanded my sanctified ones”: the ones who hear the gospel and begin to cleanse themselves of the sin we lived in, because we acknowledge this is truth and change our lives to follow the scriptures. “I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger”: as we go out and teach and prophesy, it is not by coincidence. The strange so-called meteors that come down and then go right back up as red orbs are the chariots, the mighty angels God is sending to visit the earth and make sure things go according to prophecy, fulfilling his will.

“The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together”: that is the war. “The Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.” The Lord of hosts is the one making all of it happen.

As prophecy is fulfilled the prophets go out teaching, and that is the Lord’s mercy to us, to let us know we are living in the last times, as Isaiah 30:20 says we shall see our teachers. Our people see the wars on the news and begin to realize this is not normal, and they open their spirit to learn this Bible and prepare, understanding that Jacob’s trouble is on the way. We must be prepared before that day.

Who will they kill? “And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.”

They are not coming after the camps talking about multiple wives and wanting to defile our sisters and pass them around, or the brothers talking all kind of lewd behavior. They are not a threat. We are the threat. That is why they shut down our pages and black us out: they do not want us bringing forth the prophecy. Leave the brothers with no job, who do not marry the sisters, up on YouTube as the face of the black Hebrew Israelite. No: we are the face of the twelve tribes of Israel, teaching the truth according to the law.

It is the law and the testimony, the commandments of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ. There is a light here. That is why we speak like this.

sense.text:
Stop believing in these other nations and in this false science. A lizard sent to a DNA test came back Ashkenazi Jew; you cannot use DNA testing as proof of who the twelve tribes of Israel are. That is asinine. We are the seed of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich).” The Lord says to the twelve tribes: I know all your work. You built countries and kingdoms on the earth. And all the tribulation: the real Holocaust. And thou art rich, because we are the lineage of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the true inheritors of this earth.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” They are not the Jews according to Christ. They are the devil.

“Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer.” This goes right back to Matthew 24: toward the end, with the wars and famines and destruction, he says do not fear when they come for you, do not fear the things you are about to suffer.

“Behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison.” They will pass laws to put us in prison. That is why they keep creating detention camps and facilities. They fill them with people they call illegal aliens to justify them, but ultimately they are for the twelve tribes of Israel. Imagine they say, we will turn over twenty-five percent of the space to the Israelites now; it looks like a bunch of lawbreakers, though no law is broken. We are the real illegal aliens. We are the ones to meditate on what the Lord is telling us to prepare for.

“That ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death.” Imagine ten days in a detention facility being tortured. Imagine your children slain in front of you, or your wife, your family, the brothers you war with, just to make you say you are not the twelve tribes, that Christ is not black, and they will spare your life. Hell no. That is why we have nothing to lose in these last days. We are the Punisher 10.0. We have nothing to lose and everything to gain. They do not have power over our souls.

“Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.” We read it and do not understand what faithful unto death means. Put yourself there: there is nothing these nations can do to scare me, nothing they can take, to make me turn and betray my eternal life. There is no resurrection for them.

“He that hath an ear, let him hear”: you have to be spiritual, and keeping the commandments, to understand this. Not the one in the midst of whoremongering, wanting women to work for him, using the scriptures he knows to manipulate the two-thirds of Israel, or even some of the one-third that is starting to humble down and say, I have to keep the commandments or I will not receive salvation. Sit in that reality check.

“He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.” That is the death the Lord has power over: the death over your soul.

precepts.why:
We are going into the period of Jacob’s trouble. Esau already has enough information and does not want this gospel preached any further; they will do whatever it takes to try to stop prophecy.

“Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ”: our kingdom is soon to come. But before then, “the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.” That is the tribulation ten days: being accused day and night, losing our lives for this gospel.

“And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony”: the testimony of this gospel, believing it so that when persecution comes we do not fold. We do not care about white Jesus or any doctrine outside the doctrine of the twelve tribes of Israel redeemed from our oppressors, Babylon America.

“And they loved not their lives unto the death.” We must not try to spare our lives when Jacob’s trouble takes off. Loving not your life unto death means resisting any temptation to go against your God and your people. Don’t be no damn traitor.

This is what we will sacrifice to get what is actually ours: eternal life, the kingdom of heaven.

“I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice.” Every time the prophets go out to teach the word, they present their bodies a living sacrifice. All the prophets in the Bible did, even to death. John was banished on the Isle of Patmos; James was beheaded. They were martyred: they understood the mission, and the brothers and sisters have to understand the mission too. We are the true martyrs.

sense.text:
These nations are watching us. They understand that we are the prophets and the only ones who can interpret prophecy; this is the only book that is alive, and no one else can read it and understand it.

“The soul in anguish the troubled spirit, crieth unto thee. Hear, O Lord, and have mercy.” “Have pity upon us, because we have sinned before thee.” That is the mindset we have to have in these last days: Lord, we have sinned against you.

“Hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites, and of their children, which have sinned before thee.” That is the sins of our forefathers who died, and also the real martyrs, the real prophets of the Most High sealed over periods of tribulation and torture meant to make us deny our Lord, and the ones to come in Revelation 6. “For the which cause these plagues cleave unto us.”

“Thou hast put thy fear in our hearts, to the intent that we should call upon thy name, and praise thee in our captivity: for we have called to mind all the iniquity of our forefathers.” That is why we are here now. We have acknowledged our iniquities. Heavenly Father, we acknowledge our sins; we are repenting. Remember the promise you made to our forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and see our cause.

“Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity.” These fake Jews are not in captivity; we are. “Where thou hast scattered us”: the Lord put us here, “for a reproach and a curse.” A reproach is coming off a slave ship butt naked, being separated from your children and family, an embarrassment, at the bottom of society, assimilating. “And to be subject to payments”: the other nations’ faces on the money and we not even in our own land, when they are supposed to be paying tribute to us.

Our forefathers understood they were in a day of captivity. Today the unrepentant two-thirds of Israel, who just want to party and play games, have no understanding of what is going on around them: that today is your day of captivity. But out of that captivity, if you keep God’s laws, there comes deliverance. We are scattered for a reproach because we refused to humble down and keep God’s commandments. You cannot straddle the fence, stay in sin and pleasure today and expect the kingdom tomorrow.

Subject to payments: that is what ninety, ninety-five percent of our people complain about all day, the funds, the money, men and women alike hustling, robbing, stealing or whoremongering for it.

“Hear, Israel, the commandments of life”: we have to start taking heed to the commandments of life. “How happeneth it Israel, that thou art in thine enemies’ land, that thou art waxen old in a strange country, that thou art defiled with the dead, That thou art counted with them that go down into the grave?” We are counted as the walking dead.

We are counted as dead and coming back into repentance. Death is on the doorstep of the other nations, and the Lord is doing it as a ransom. So what are you going to do? Play games with your iniquity, with your salvation, delay when it is time to gather together?

precepts.why:
What are we going to do? The Lord is doing all these things, but we have a purpose in how we must conduct ourselves in these last days.

“Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly.” This is why the Lord says to gather ourselves together. Those at home watching on the internet who have not made it to fellowship yet: the Lord wants you to have leaders in front of you, in an environment where we exhort one another daily as we see the day approaching. “Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts.”

“Let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them.” “Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.”

Knowing the time we live in, the Lord wants us sanctified: to cleanse ourselves, repent, and acknowledge what we did wrong, so that when God brings judgment on this earth we will be part of the chosen that are spared in the day of his judgment.

sense.text: As the tribulation happens, we have to align ourselves and understand what the Lord is telling us to do. “They continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.”

“And all that believed were together, and had all things common”: there is nothing lacking amongst us. “And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.” There is lack, but you look out for the believers, the ones striving and getting themselves together. There has to be a unification.

“Continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house.” They were of one accord, breaking bread house to house and of one accord with finances, making sure that no one who lacked was in a constraint. “And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.” The Lord is going to add more believers.

precepts.why:
As these times come to pass, we have to strive to be amongst each other, and try our best to separate ourselves from these other nations and from the unbelievers, because they will keep coming for us. Selling your possessions does not mean selling your last; it means if you have excess, we have to start consolidating, because we understand this place is over.

“Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.” The Lord wants us to set up a righteous underground railroad, looking out for the believers, being more selfless instead of selfish, not running up credit cards and debt as though no tribulation were coming.

The military is using AI, not only for war strategy but to track you and get into your personal business. Facebook and the social media were made to track you. Esau comes up with a kill list once a week; the drones will be used, and a lot of the prophets will be taken out by this technology, made to look like a terror attack. The Lord is telling us in advance so we prepare. Use AI wisely, and be mindful of everything you tell it: the data you share is more valuable than anything given to Google, and it is being used as a weapon. Ask it about the saying that the Jews left black and came back white, attributed to Gamal Abdel Nasser, and it calls it a fabricated quote. That is a lie; it is a true quote, and before AI you could easily pull it up. All this technology is for weaponry and propaganda, and AI is against us.

sense.text:
Kindness to strangers is not the measure of character; kindness at home is the real test. As we gather together, we have to fix our character flaws, show ourselves friendly, and endure. We have to strive for brotherhood. Endeavor is not a word to be taken lightly; it is an enduring word.

“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” The Lord says to gather together the nation that is hated upon the earth. In the last days we gather together according to Acts 2, with the believers that fear the Lord, and make a lot of things common, so that we do not lack. You cannot say to your brother, be warmed and filled, and go your way. Your true charity is shown in adversity.

precepts.why:
“In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.” The unity of brethren; the love of neighbours, charity and long-suffering; a man and a wife that agree together on the commandments, not arguing about the curtains. Brother, when did you become an interior decorator? Let your wife handle that. Chicken or lamb? Surprise me.

Brotherhood and unity do not mean you cannot correct one another or admonish one another; they mean you expect highly. Your people are those who push you toward hard things and tell you harsh truths when lies would be easier. We need correction, admonishment, counsel and advice amongst each other. Real admonishment and love come with some hard criticism, and you cannot take it emotionally or personally. Tell the brother he is fat, a lard ass: fix it, brother. Because we love one another, we do not suffer sin upon one another; if a brother or sister is in sin, they may need that rough talk to put them back in the righteous mindset.

sense.text:
As these perilous times come and Jacob’s trouble is ushered in, we are going to be all we have. One shall betray another. Family members that hate this truth will turn you in for a little fiat money, a bounty on your head, dead or alive. Your mother will choose white Jesus over you.

Tobit was a man of charity, a perfect example of how we should be. He kept the feast of Pentecost and was mindful of the Lord, and he had an abundance of meat because he prepared for perilous times. In a famine, a brother like Tobit is a good brother. “Go and bring what poor man soever thou shalt find out of our brethren, who is mindful of the Lord; and, lo, I tarry for thee.”

“One of our nation is strangled, and is cast out in the marketplace. Then before I had tasted of any meat, I started up, and took him up into a room.” He “ate my meat in heaviness”, remembering Amos: “Your feasts shall be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.”

Tobit had a charitable spirit, and that is how we have to move. As times get tough, these are the loyal men you want to be around, to nurture and look out for one another. And do not think that because Tobit was charitable he did not correct anybody. We have to stop this emotional Christianity mindset.

“Bring forth the men that are come to thee.” “And the woman took the two men, and hid them”, and sent the pursuers the wrong way, for “she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax.”

Some brothers and sisters are going to be looked to to hide the prophets. Tobit, Rahab: these examples are here for our learning. As we build this spiritual underground railroad, some of us will be required to help one another, and sometimes helping our brothers and sisters puts you in danger.

“Then she let them down by a cord through the window”, and told them, “Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days.” She not only helped the prophets; she gave them an exit.

Is that you, sister? Is that you, brother? Are you ready to do that for your nation, or to sell out to keep this carnal body that gets headaches, diarrhea and belly aches and dies of infirmities? We have to be ready in these last days.

“Let brotherly love continue”: in these last days we must let brotherly love continue. “Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.”

As we see the prophecies come to pass, we know tribulation is coming. Set up brothers and sisters around you. Start small: have the guest room in your household ready to receive a guest. If you cannot afford an extra room, instead of the leather couch get a pullout bed couch; turn a little space into a room with a bed. If a prophet is on the run and you can give shelter for two days, a meal and shelter for a prophet, that is a blessing for you. That is hospitality and long-suffering one to another.

“Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them”: those put in bonds for things pertaining to this ministry, not a thief or someone who did evil. “And them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.” That is the epitome of loving your neighbour as yourself: when a commandment keeper goes through trial for this ministry, do whatever it takes to support them. Be there in the time of affliction, and watch how the Lord provides for you.

“Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.” That is why we have to strengthen the marriages. “Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.” The Lord will never leave us, but do not forsake the Lord.
“So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper”: the Lord has my back. “And I will not fear what man shall do unto me.” You can kill this body; I do not care what men can do to me.

There is a difference. The Most High deals with the twelve tribes of Israel; he made a covenant with our forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and we must understand this in these last days.

“It is good, being put to death by men, to look for hope from God to be raised up again by him.” It is good that this mortal body is slain; we look for a resurrection from the Almighty, to be raised up again.

“As for thee, thou shalt have no resurrection to life.” As for the heathen, the fake Jews, the Iranians, all these other nations: there is no resurrection for them. That is the difference between the twelve tribes of Israel and the other nations.

precepts.why:
This has to be our mindset concerning salvation and gathering with our people. “So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies”: the salvation of the righteous, and the destruction of those that are against us.

So do not get scared when you see your enemies’ blood being shed. Some blood might splatter on you; do not get scared.

sense.text:
Until we receive our homeland, we are all we have. We have to endeavor to keep the unity, desire one another, show ourselves friendly, exhort each other, show charity and mercy one to another, as we keep these commandments. I have no favorite place until I get my homeland back; my favorite people are the faithful brothers and sisters that keep the commandments, and wherever they are is my favorite place. We are pilgrims and nomads on the earth.

“Give ear, my son, receive my advice”: give ear, twelve tribes. The Lord is giving us advice. “And refuse not my counsel”: do not turn away from what you are hearing.

“And put thy feet into her fetters, and thy neck into her chain.” That is wisdom: the laws, statutes and commandments, the restraint. “Come unto her with thy whole heart”: come in sincerity to serve the Lord.

“When thou hast got hold of her, let her not go.” Do not let go of this truth in these last days. “For at the last thou shalt find her rest, and that shall be turned to thy joy.” No matter what happens to this fleshly body, it will be turned to joy when we keep these commandments, in the faith of the Messiah.

“Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for thee.” At first it was heavy; now it is a strong defence. “For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.” “Thou shalt put her on as a robe of honour.” It is an honour to keep the commandments in the last days. “A crown of joy”: this is your joy, your strength, in these last days.

“If thou wilt apply thy mind, thou shalt be prudent.” You have to study; that is where your faith comes in. Be around the brethren, and do not be afraid to be corrected. “If thou love to hear, thou shalt receive understanding”: the Lord will give it to you abundantly. “If thou bow thine ear, thou shalt be wise”: a wise brother or sister in these last days.
“Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave unto him that is wise.” We need to be around the leadership.
